# A + 同 + B · *A + tung4 + B*

**Meaning:** and; with · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Connecting words

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Ftung4-and-with).

同 joins two nouns ('and') or says who you do something with ('with'). It joins nouns and people, not whole sentences.

**Written Chinese:** 和 / 跟 — Written Chinese uses 和 or 跟.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我同佢去睇戲。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 tung4 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 hei3. |
| Yale | ngóh tùhng kéuih heui tái hei. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄊㄨㄥ⁴ ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄊㄜㄧ² ㄏㄝㄧ³. |
| English | I'm going to see a film with her. |
